description: This file defines a utility class 'FileHelper' for loading resource files into strings, performing macro substitutions, and handling template processing within a Java project.

classes.name: FileHelper
classes.description: Utility class to load resource files into strings and perform macro substitutions.

methods.name: loadTemplate
methods.description: Loads a resource file into a StringBuffer, skipping lines starting with '##'.

methods.name: translateBuffer
methods.description: Performs macro substitution on a StringBuffer using a MacroSource.

methods.name: translateSimpleBuffer
methods.description: Loads a template and performs a single key/value macro substitution.

methods.name: translateBufferTemplate
methods.description: Loads a template and performs macro substitution using provided macros.
